About this role:
Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Software Engineer in Technology as part of Commercial Corporate & Investment Bank Technology (CCIBT) engineering and transformation office. Learn more about the career areas and lines of business at wellsfargojobs.com .
The Senior Software Engineer will directly support the Market Data Service Layer, an internal Wells Fargo market data platform which sources data from multiple market data providers via connections to a third party service owned and managed by the vendor.
In this role, you will:
Lead moderately complex initiatives and deliverables within technical domain environments
Contribute to large scale planning of strategies
Design, code, test, debug, and document for projects and programs associated with technology domain, including upgrades and deployments
Review moderately complex technical challenges that require an in-depth evaluation of technologies and procedures
Resolve moderately complex issues and lead a team to meet existing client needs or potential new clients needs while leveraging solid understanding of the function, policies, procedures, or compliance requirements
Collaborate and consult with peers, colleagues, and mid-level managers to resolve technical challenges and achieve goals
Lead projects and act as an escalation point, provide guidance and direction to less experienced staff
Required Qualifications:
4+ years of Software Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
Desired Qualifications:
4+ years of technology development and strategy experience in Full Stack development with hands on coding experience with C# .NET Core
Experience with UI Framework like Blazor/Angular/ React
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python is added advantage
Experience working with Oracle or SQL Server databases with ability to write Medium/complex queries
Proven experience architecting and building AI–powered solutions, including LLM integration, prompt engineering, RAG patterns, model orchestration, AI pipelines, and responsible AI practices.
Strong understanding of GenAI trends, ecosystem evolution, and emerging capabilities, with the ability to assess vendor offerings versus build strategies.
Experience embedding AI into core business workflows to drive productivity, risk reduction, customer experience, and operational efficiency.
Passion for experimentation, rapid prototyping, and data‑driven decision‑making.
Experience with Windows and Web services
Experience in Event driven architecture using Kafka Event Streaming
Familiarity with REST API development and related tools (e.g. Postman, swagger)
Build Unit Tests using XUnit and Automation Tests using Selenium, C#
Strong JavaScript/Typescript and Advance JS proficiency and responsive design knowledge (HTML5, CSS3, SASS, Bootstrap)
Experience working with Oracle or SQL Server databases with ability to write Medium/complex queries
Hands on experience adopting and implementing engineering practices such as TDD, BDD, Developer lead functional automation, Automated deployment
Experience integrating front-end with back-end services.
Should have good knowledge of DevOps Processes and tools.
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Strong work experience in Agile/Scrum methodology
Ability to work independently with all stakeholders under minimal supervision
should be flexible about work hours to provide better overlap with the US team
Proven track record of leading large scale complex projects and influencing cross-functional teams.

About this role:
Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Software Engineer within the Consumer Technology (CT) organization- providing technology solutions to the LOBs and manage the application portfolios through the enablers of skills, stability, security, scalability, speed, and success. Learn more about the career areas and business divisions at wellsfargojobs.com .
The Lead Software Engineer will serve as a key technical contributor for Customer Account Servicing (CAS) team. This role is responsible for designing, developing, testing, and deploying software solutions, while actively participating in all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, and architectural planning. The LSE will leverage modern technologies, including Generative AI and integration tools, to deliver scalable and innovative solutions.
In this role, you will:
Lead complex technology initiatives including those that are companywide with broad impact
Act as a key participant in developing standards and companywide best practices for engineering complex and large scale technology solutions for technology engineering disciplines
Design and develop scalable, resilient microservices using Java, Spring, and Spring Boot
Build and enhance responsive, high-performing UI applications using React and TypeScript
Review and analyze complex, large-scale technology solutions for tactical and strategic business objectives, enterprise technological environment, and technical challenges that require in-depth evaluation of multiple factors, including intangibles or unprecedented technical factors
Make decisions in developing standard and companywide best practices for engineering and technology solutions requiring understanding of industry best practices and new technologies, influencing and leading technology team to meet deliverables and drive new initiatives
Collaborate and consult with key technical experts, senior technology team, and external industry groups to resolve complex technical issues and achieve goals
Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering engineering excellence and best practices
Required Qualifications:
5+ years of Software Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
4+ years of experience with Java and Spring/Spring Boot for building scalable microservices
4+ years of experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React and TypeScript
3+ years of experience with API design and development (RESTful and GraphQL)
2+ years of experience with MongoDB or other NoSQL databases
Desired Qualifications:
2+ years of experience with version control systems such as Git
2+ years experience with event streaming platforms such as Kafka
2+ years experience with caching technologies such as Redis
1+ year of experience with AI/ML concepts, including:Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
Deep expertise in microservices architecture and distributed systems design
Strong understanding of frontend-backend integration patterns using API-driven architecture
Experience working in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Knowledge of observability practices, including logging, monitoring, and tracing
Experience with DevOps and CI/CD tools such as:
Jenkins, Harness, Artifactory, SonarQube, Checkmarx, Black Duck, Splunk

About this role:
This is an opportunity to lead at the intersection of data, engineering, AI, and Legal Technology , where the platforms your team builds directly enable how a complex organization manages critical legal data and operations.
Wells Fargo is seeking a Software Engineering Manager to lead a global engineering team building, modernizing, and operating the data platforms that power Legal Technology . You’ll bring together strong engineering leadership, data expertise, and operational discipline to deliver trusted, secure, and scalable solutions while helping create the data foundation for the next generation of AI-enabled Legal capabilities.
This role is built for a leader who wants to stay connected to the technology while developing great engineers, solving complex problems, and partnering across Legal, Product, Architecture, Information Security, and Technology . You’ll help turn evolving business needs into practical engineering solutions and lead a team accountable for delivering them.
If you’re energized by building strong teams, modernizing complex technology, solving meaningful data challenges, and turning AI potential into real-world capabilities , this is an opportunity to make an impact .
What Success Looks Like:
You’ll build a team that delivers reliable, secure, scalable, and well-governed technology , strengthens the quality and accessibility of Legal data, and creates a strong foundation for AI-enabled capabilities.
You’ll be equally focused on engineering excellence, operational stability, talent development, and building trusted partnerships across the organization.
You’ll thrive here if you’re a hands-on engineering leader who can connect technology to business outcomes, develop great engineers, navigate complexity, and turn challenging problems into practical solutions.
In this role, you will:
Manage, coach, and develop a globally distributed team of engineers delivering Legal Technology data platforms, applications, pipelines, and integrations.
Lead the delivery and modernization of data solutions supporting legal hold, matter lifecycle management, and legal operations.
Partner with architects and experienced engineers to align solutions with enterprise architecture, data strategy, application modernization, and technology standards.
Guide technical design and engineering quality across SQL, ETL/data pipelines, APIs, batch processing, secure file transfers, CI/CD, DevSecOps, and containerized environments .
Strengthen data quality, governance, lineage, access, retention, privacy, and readiness for AI-enabled capabilities.
Drive security and operational excellence through vulnerability remediation, technology currency, release management, production support, incident management, and root cause analysis.
Serve as an escalation point for complex engineering and production issues, removing roadblocks and improving platform reliability, scalability, and performance.
Partner with Product Managers and Product Owners to influence technology priorities, roadmaps, requirements, and delivery outcomes.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, technical excellence, experimentation, and continuous improvement.
Identify opportunities to apply AI, machine learning, and automation to improve Legal Technology workflows and business outcomes.
Required Qualifications:
5+ years of Software Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education.
2+ years of Leadership experience.
3+ Years of Datawarehouse, Datamart, Data lakes etc.
Desired Qualifications:
Legal Engineering experience: Experience applying technology, automation, AI, and data-driven solutions to legal workflows, including translating legal and business needs into scalable technology solutions.
Experience in Legal Technology OR Legal Technology Startups.
Experience leading software engineering, data engineering, data platform, or application development teams.
Strong knowledge of SQL, relational databases, ETL/data pipelines, APIs, integrations, and enterprise data environments.
Experience with modern engineering practices such as Git, CI/CD, automated testing, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, Helm, and secrets management.
Experience with data quality, governance, lineage, security, and privacy within complex or regulated environments.
Experience managing production applications, releases, incidents, vulnerabilities, and technology risk.
The ability to provide technical direction while coaching and developing engineering talent.
Experience leading or partnering with globally distributed and offshore engineering teams.
Strong communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills in a highly matrixed organization.
Experience with Legal or Compliance technology, including platforms such as Onit or Exterro , is a plus.
Experience applying AI/ML or automation to enterprise workflows is highly desirable.
Job Expectations and Core Values:
Be Humble: You're smart yet always interested in learning from others
Work Transparently: You always deal in an honest, direct, and transparent way.
Take Ownership: You embrace responsibility and find joy in having the answers.
Learn More: You regularly self-educate and improve your skill set.
Show Gratitude: You show appreciation and respect to those you work with.
This Role offers a Hybrid work environment with 3 days in office.
There is No Visa Sponsorship available at this time for this role.

About this role:
Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Java Engineer to join the Spread Technology team in Fixed Income, supporting asset classes such as Structured Products, Credit, and Municipal Bonds. This role is pivotal to the success of strategic initiatives Front Office Sales and Trading applications, and is designed for engineers who thrive in high-performance, front-to-back delivery environments.
You will lead the design and development of low-latency Micro UIs and robust backend services, contributing to pricing and risk workflows. The ideal candidate will demonstrate technical leadership, deep domain knowledge in capital markets, and a passion for building scalable, resilient software solutions using modern technologies such as Angular, Java, Spring, Kafka, and Apache Ignite.
In this role, you will:
Lead complex initiatives on selected domains
Ensure systems are monitored to increase operational efficiency and managed to mitigate risk
Define opportunities to maximize resource utilization and improve processes while reducing cost
Lead, design, develop, test and implement applications and system components, tools and utilities, models, simulation, and analytics to manage complex business functions using sophisticated technologies
Resolve coding, testing and escalated platform issues of a technically challenging nature
Lead team to ensure compliance and risk management requirements for supported area are met and work with other stakeholders to implement key risk initiatives

Utilize build tools such as Maven or Gradle and ensure code quality using SonarQube.
Provide technical support and resolve issues related to supported applications
Create test data and conduct interface and unit tests.
Design, code, test, debug, and document programs using Agile development practices
Partner with production support and platform engineering teams effectively

5+ years of Specialty Software Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

3+ years of experience in high-performance programming using Java or Python
3+ years of experience in full stack development using Angular/Typescript for front-end and Java with Spring Framework for back-end
3+ years of experience with Apache Kafka for messaging and stream processing
Desired Qualifications:
Experience using OpenShift / Kubernetes container platforms
Experience designing and delivering cloud-native, microservices-oriented solutions at enterprise scale in financial services or regulated sectors
Experience with test automation using tools such as Selenium.
Strong understanding of performance and stress testing web UIs using Chrome DevTools
5+ years of experience with Apache Kafka for messaging and stream processing
5+ years of experience with Apache Ignite for in-memory computing.
5+ years of experience with build tools such as Maven or Gradle
5+ years of experience with code quality tools like SonarQube
5+ years of experience as a Full Stack Developer with strong understanding of front-end and back-end development
5+ years of experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Splunk, Grafana, AppDynamics, New Relic, Elastic, or Open Telemetry

Wells Fargo is back in the office colborating for fabulous outcomes!
This role is a hybrid position and in the office three days and work from home two days a week.
There is no visa sponsorships or visa transfers for this role.
We’re looking for a motivated, highly organized Lead Information Security Engineer who knows how to drive vulnerability remediation from identification through resolution.
This is not a role where you simply receive vulnerability reports and pass them along. You will take ownership of the process.
Security vulnerabilities may be identified through enterprise scanning and vendor announcements across all our infrastructure platforms like firewalls, routers, switches, application, and more. You will organize and track those findings, identify the appropriate engineering owners, work across teams to understand remediation plans and timelines, and provide clear reporting on when patches or fixes will be implemented.
The right person will be comfortable working across multiple engineering teams, keeping a large number of vulnerabilities and remediation activities organized, and following issues through to resolution. You will be someone who takes initiative, asks the right questions, follows up consistently, and can influence technical teams without losing sight of deadlines and risk.
What will make you successful in this role
We’re especially interested in candidates who have experience:
Managing or coordinating security vulnerability remediation
Working with vendor vulnerability reports, security advisories, patches, and remediation activities
Identifying the appropriate engineering or technology owner for a vulnerability
Driving follow-up with engineering teams to establish remediation plans and timelines
Tracking multiple vulnerabilities, owners, dependencies, and target dates simultaneously
Providing clear, organized status reporting on vulnerabilities and remediation progress
Working across security, infrastructure, network, application, and engineering teams
Taking ownership and proactively driving work forward rather than waiting for direction
This role requires more than general information security experience. We are looking for someone who can lead vulnerability tracking and remediation efforts, work effectively with technical engineering teams, and bring strong organization, follow-through, and accountability to the process.
In this role, you will:
Lead computer security incident response activities for highly complex events
Provide security consulting on large projects for internal lines of business to ensure conformity with corporate information, security policy, and standards
Document, test, maintain, and provide issue resolution recommendations for highly complex security solutions related to networking, cryptography, cloud, authentication and directory services, email, internet, applications, and endpoint security
Review and correlate security logs
Utilize subject matter knowledge in industry leading security solutions and best practices to implement one or more components of information security such as availability, integrity, confidentiality, risk management, threat identification, modeling, monitoring, incident response, access management, and business continuity
Identify security vulnerabilities and issues, perform risk assessments, and evaluate remediation alternatives
Collaborate and influence all levels of professionals including managers
Required Qualifications:
5+ years of Network / Information Security Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
5+ years of technical experience with Network/Security devices, Asset Management experience or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
3 + Years Project management. Exceptional project management skills and a demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities to success in a rapidly changing environment.
3+ Years Data analytics. Skilled at analyzing data sets, drawing out conclusions and trends, and communicating those trends to broader audiences.
Effective communicator. Writes clearly, compellingly, and in a way that breaks down complex topics into their most important components.
Desired Qualifications:
Certifications like CCNA/CISSP/Security+
